test_cases.title: OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci olmadan istek gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır ve hedef endpoint erişilebilir durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Authorization başlığı içermeyen HTTP GET istegi.

steps.action: Authorization başlığı içermeyen bir HTTP isteği ağ geçidine gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi isteği reddeder ve HTTP 401 yanıt kodu döner.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci ile istek gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz (süresi dolmuş veya format hatalı) OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci.

steps.action: Authorization başlığında geçersiz bir OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci taşıyan HTTP isteği ağ geçidine gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi isteği reddeder ve HTTP 401 yanıt kodu döner.

test_cases.title: Rol yetkisi olmayan endpoint'e istek gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Geçerli bir OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci vardır ve bu belirtecin rolü, hedef endpoint'e erişim yetkisine sahip değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci ve yetkisiz endpoint URL'si.
test_cases.assumptions: Endpoint rol tabanlı yetkilendirme kuralları yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: Geçerli OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci taşıyan ancak rolü o endpoint'e erişim yetkisi olmayan bir HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi isteği reddeder ve HTTP 403 yanıt kodu döner.

test_cases.title: Rol yetkisi olan endpoint'e istek gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Geçerli bir OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci vardır ve bu belirtecin rolü, hedef endpoint'e erişim yetkisine sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci ve yetkili endpoint URL'si.
test_cases.assumptions: Endpoint rol tabanlı yetkilendirme kuralları yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: Geçerli OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci taşıyan ve rolü o endpoint'e erişim yetkisi olan bir HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi isteği kabul eder ve HTTP 403 yanıt kodu dönmez (istek işlenir veya 200/2xx serisi yanıt döner).

test_cases.title: Dakikada 600 istek sınırının aşılmaması durumunda isteklerin iletilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi aktif durumdadır ve hedeflenen arka uç servisi yanıt vermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir istemci kimliği ile 600 adet HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: İstekler tam olarak 60 saniyelik bir zaman dilimi içinde gönderilmektedir.

steps.action: Tek bir istemci kimliği kullanarak 60 saniye içinde 600 adet geçerli HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: Tüm istekler arka uca iletilir ve HTTP 429 yanıtı alınmaz.

test_cases.title: Dakikada 600 istek sınırının aşıldığında HTTP 429 ve Retry-After yanıtı
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi aktif durumdadır ve hedeflenen arka uç servisi yanıt vermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir istemci kimliği ile 60 saniye içinde 601 adet HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: İstekler tam olarak 60 saniyelik bir zaman dilimi içinde gönderilmektedir.

steps.action: Tek bir istemci kimliği kullanarak 60 saniye içinde ilk 600 istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: İlk 600 istek başarılı yanıt alır.

steps.action: Aynı istemci kimliğiyle aynı dakika içinde 601. istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi HTTP 429 durum kodu ve 'Retry-After' başlığı içeren bir yanıt döndürür.

test_cases.title: 2000 istek/saniye yük altında 99. yüzdelik gecikmenin 20 ms sınırı
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi ve arka uç servisi yük testine hazırdır. Gecikme ölçüm aracı yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Saniyede 2000 isteklik sürekli bir HTTP yükü.
test_cases.assumptions: Ölçüm, yükün stabil hale gelmesinden sonra en az 60 saniye boyunca alınmaktadır.

steps.action: Ağ geçidine saniyede 2000 isteklik bir yük uygulanır ve istek yanıt süreleri kaydedilir.
steps.expected: Test süresi boyunca 99. yüzdelik (p99) yanıt süresi 20 ms'yi geçmez.

test_cases.title: Arka uç servisi 5 saniyeden uzun süre yanıt vermediğinde HTTP 504 yanıtı
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi aktif durumdadır. Arka uç servisi, gelen isteklere 5 saniyeden uzun süre yanıt vermemek üzere yapılandırılmıştır (örneğin 10 saniyelik bir gecikme).
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: Ağ geçidinin zaman aşımı eşiği 5 saniye olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: Arka uç servisine bir HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi, 5 saniye bekledikten sonra isteği sonlandırır ve istemciye HTTP 504 durum kodu döndürür.

test_cases.title: Configuration change applied without restart and without dropping in-flight requests
test_cases.preconditions: The gateway is running with a default configuration. A long-running request (e.g., a stream or a slow API call) is currently in-flight.
test_cases.assumptions: A method to update configuration (e.g., API call or file watch) is available and does not trigger a process restart by default.

steps.action: Initiate a long-running request to the gateway and keep it active.
steps.expected: The request is accepted and processing begins.

steps.action: Apply a configuration change (e.g., update rate limit or routing rule) via the configuration interface.
steps.expected: The configuration change is acknowledged successfully. The gateway process ID remains unchanged (no restart).

steps.action: Wait for the in-flight request to complete.
steps.expected: The in-flight request completes successfully with a valid response (not dropped or timed out due to config change).

steps.action: Send a new request that matches the changed configuration.
steps.expected: The new configuration is applied to the new request.

test_cases.title: Verification of log fields for a standard request
test_cases.preconditions: The gateway is configured to write logs to a specific file or log stream. The logging feature is enabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid HTTP GET request to a known endpoint.
test_cases.assumptions: Log entries are written in a structured format (e.g., JSON) or a parseable text format.

steps.action: Send a valid HTTP request to the gateway with a unique client identifier (e.g., User-Agent or API Key).
steps.expected: The gateway processes the request and returns a response.

steps.action: Retrieve the log entry corresponding to this request.
steps.expected: A log entry exists for the request.

steps.action: Inspect the log entry for the required fields.
steps.expected: The log entry contains: a unique tracking ID, the client identifier, the endpoint URL, the HTTP response code, and the request duration (in milliseconds or seconds).

test_cases.title: Verification of log fields for an error response
test_cases.preconditions: The gateway is configured to write logs. A route exists that will return a 404 or 500 error.
test_cases.test_inputs: An HTTP request to a non-existent or faulty endpoint.
test_cases.assumptions: The gateway logs error responses in the same format as successful responses.

steps.action: Send an HTTP request to an endpoint that returns a 404 Not Found or 500 Internal Server Error.
steps.expected: The gateway returns the error response to the client.

steps.action: Retrieve the log entry corresponding to this failed request.
steps.expected: A log entry exists for the request.

steps.action: Inspect the log entry for the required fields.
steps.expected: The log entry contains: a unique tracking ID, the client identifier, the endpoint URL, the specific error response code (404 or 500), and the request duration.

test_cases.title: Classification of a document with high confidence
test_cases.test_inputs: A sample document clearly belonging to a defined category.

steps.action: Submit the sample document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a classification result.

steps.action: Verify the returned category.
steps.expected: The category is exactly one of the 12 defined categories.

steps.action: Verify the returned confidence score.
steps.expected: The confidence score is a number between 0 and 1.

test_cases.title: Routing of a document with low confidence to human review
test_cases.test_inputs: A document engineered or selected to yield a confidence score below 0.60.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows monitoring of the human review queue.

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service processes the document.

steps.action: Check the confidence score returned or logged.
steps.expected: The confidence score is below 0.60.

steps.action: Check the status of the document in the system.
steps.expected: The document is routed to the human review queue and not classified automatically.

test_cases.title: Boundary case for confidence score exactly at 0.60
test_cases.test_inputs: A document engineered or selected to yield a confidence score of exactly 0.60.
test_cases.assumptions: The system can produce or simulate a confidence score of exactly 0.60.

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service processes the document.

steps.action: Check the confidence score returned or logged.
steps.expected: The confidence score is 0.60.

steps.action: Check the status of the document in the system.
steps.expected: The document is classified automatically (not routed to human review), as the requirement specifies 'below 0.60' for routing.

test_cases.title: Verification of top three contributing passages
test_cases.test_inputs: A sample document containing distinct, identifiable text segments.

steps.action: Submit the sample document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a classification result.

steps.action: Inspect the explanation data returned with the classification.
steps.expected: The response includes exactly three text passages.

steps.action: Verify the content of the passages.
steps.expected: The three passages are substrings or extracted segments from the submitted document.

test_cases.title: Macro-averaged F1 score verification on held-out set
test_cases.preconditions: The classification model is trained and ready for evaluation. A held-out evaluation set with ground truth labels is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Held-out evaluation dataset with known ground truth labels.
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation script calculates the macro-averaged F1 score correctly according to standard definitions.

steps.action: Run the classification model on the held-out evaluation set to generate predictions for all documents.
steps.expected: The system generates a prediction for every document in the evaluation set without errors.

steps.action: Calculate the macro-averaged F1 score by comparing the model's predictions with the ground truth labels.
steps.expected: The calculated macro-averaged F1 score is at least 0.90.

test_cases.title: Recall difference between Turkish and English documents
test_cases.preconditions: The classification model is trained and ready for evaluation. The held-out evaluation set contains a sufficient number of documents labeled with both Turkish and English language metadata.
test_cases.test_inputs: Held-out evaluation dataset containing documents explicitly tagged as Turkish and English.
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation set contains enough samples in both languages to provide statistically reliable recall estimates for the test.

steps.action: Run the classification model on the subset of the held-out evaluation set containing only Turkish documents and calculate the recall for this subset.
steps.expected: The recall value for Turkish documents is computed and recorded (R_TR).

steps.action: Run the classification model on the subset of the held-out evaluation set containing only English documents and calculate the recall for this subset.
steps.expected: The recall value for English documents is computed and recorded (R_EN).

steps.action: Calculate the absolute difference between R_TR and R_EN and compare it to the 5 percentage point threshold.
steps.expected: The absolute difference between the recall of Turkish and English documents is less than or equal to 5 percentage points.

test_cases.title: 95th percentile response time under load
test_cases.preconditions: The service is deployed and operational. A load testing tool capable of generating 50 requests per second is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: A set of valid document inputs sufficient to sustain 50 requests per second for a statistically significant duration (e.g., 10 minutes).
test_cases.assumptions: The system clock and logging infrastructure are synchronized and accurate enough to measure milliseconds.

steps.action: Generate a continuous load of 50 requests per second with valid document inputs for a duration of at least 10 minutes.
steps.expected: The service accepts all requests without error and begins processing them.

steps.action: Collect the response time for each request during the test window.
steps.expected: Response time data is recorded for every request.

steps.action: Calculate the 95th percentile of the collected response times.
steps.expected: The 95th percentile response time is less than or equal to 500 ms.

test_cases.title: Verification of request logging fields
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and the logging destination (database or file) is accessible for inspection.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single valid document input with a known content hash.
test_cases.assumptions: The current model version is known and retrievable from the service configuration or metadata.

steps.action: Send a single valid document request to the service.
steps.expected: The service returns a successful classification result.

steps.action: Inspect the log entry corresponding to the request.
steps.expected: The log entry contains the model version identifier.

steps.action: Inspect the log entry for the input hash.
steps.expected: The log entry contains the hash of the input document.

steps.action: Inspect the log entry for the predicted category.
steps.expected: The log entry contains the category predicted by the model.

test_cases.title: Alert triggered when PSI exceeds threshold
test_cases.preconditions: The service has a defined baseline distribution for predicted categories. The alerting mechanism is monitored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A dataset of requests crafted such that the resulting weekly distribution of predicted categories deviates from the baseline, resulting in a Population Stability Index (PSI) > 0.2.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows simulation or injection of classification results to test the weekly aggregation logic without waiting for a full real-time week.

steps.action: Process a set of requests that generate a predicted category distribution with a PSI greater than 0.2 relative to the baseline.
steps.expected: The service records the classification results.

steps.action: Trigger the weekly evaluation cycle or wait for the weekly check to execute.
steps.expected: The system calculates the PSI for the week.

steps.action: Monitor the alerting channel or system status.
steps.expected: An alert is raised indicating the deviation in predicted category distribution.

test_cases.title: No alert triggered when PSI is below threshold
test_cases.preconditions: The service has a defined baseline distribution for predicted categories. The alerting mechanism is monitored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A dataset of requests crafted such that the resulting weekly distribution of predicted categories is stable, resulting in a Population Stability Index (PSI) <= 0.2.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows simulation or injection of classification results to test the weekly aggregation logic without waiting for a full real-time week.

steps.action: Process a set of requests that generate a predicted category distribution with a PSI less than or equal to 0.2 relative to the baseline.
steps.expected: The service records the classification results.

steps.action: Trigger the weekly evaluation cycle or wait for the weekly check to execute.
steps.expected: The system calculates the PSI for the week.

steps.action: Monitor the alerting channel or system status.
steps.expected: No alert is raised regarding the distribution deviation.

test_cases.title: İz güncellemesinin harita üzerinde 1 saniye içinde görüntülenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem çalışır durumda, harita ekranı açık, sensör verisi gönderimi yapılabiliyor.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir sensörden gelen yeni bir iz güncellemesi mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati ve performans ölçüm aracı senkronize edilmiştir.

steps.action: Sensörden gelen iz güncellemesi mesajının sistem tarafından alındığı zaman kaydedilir.
steps.expected: Mesajın alındığı zaman戳 (timestamp) loglanır.

steps.action: Harita ekranında izin görünmeye başladığı an kaydedilir.
steps.expected: İzin haritada görünmesi, mesajın alınmasından itibaren 1 saniye veya daha kısa bir sürede gerçekleşir.

test_cases.title: 2.000 iz yükü altında ekran yenileme hızının 10 Hz üzerinde kalması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem çalışır durumda, harita ekranı açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Aynı anda 2.000 aktif iz verisi ve sürekli güncellemeler.
test_cases.assumptions: Ekran yenileme hızı yazılım arayüzünden veya performans izleme aracından ölçülebilir.

steps.action: Sisteme aynı anda 2.000 iz yüklenir.
steps.expected: Tüm 2.000 iz harita üzerinde görüntülenir.

steps.action: Ekran yenileme hızı 10 saniye boyunca izlenir.
steps.expected: Yenileme hızı hiç bir an 10 Hz'in altına düşmez.

test_cases.title: Seçilen izin detay bilgilerinin görüntülenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Harita üzerinde en az bir aktif iz bulunuyor.
test_cases.test_inputs: Harita üzerindeki bir izin koordinatları veya kimlik bilgisi.
test_cases.assumptions: İzin kimlik, hız, yön ve son güncelleme zamanı verileri sensörlerden doğru şekilde alınmıştır.

steps.action: Operatör harita üzerindeki belirli bir izi seçer (örneğin tıklama ile).
steps.expected: Seçilen izin detay bilgi penceresi veya paneli açılır.

steps.action: Görüntülenen bilgiler kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: İzin kimlik, hız, yön ve son güncelleme zamanı bilgileri doğru ve okunabilir şekilde görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: 30 saniye güncelleme almayan izin 'eskimiş' olarak işaretlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Harita üzerinde güncel bir iz bulunuyor, sensörden bu iz için veri akışı durdurulabilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Güncelleme durdurulan tek bir iz.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati hassas ve izlenebilir.

steps.action: Belirli bir iz için sensörden gelen güncelleme verileri durdurulur.
steps.expected: İz haritada mevcut, 'eskimiş' işareti yok.

steps.action: 30 saniye beklenir.
steps.expected: İz harita üzerinde 'eskimiş' olarak işaretlenir (örneğin renkten veya simgeden ayırt edilebilir).

test_cases.title: 120 saniye güncelleme almayan izin görüntüden kaldırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Harita üzerinde 'eskimiş' olarak işaretlenmiş bir iz bulunuyor (30 saniye önce güncelleme durduruldu).
test_cases.test_inputs: Güncellemesi durdurulmuş iz.

steps.action: İzin 'eskimiş' işaretlenmesinden sonra 90 saniye daha beklenir (toplam 120 saniye).
steps.expected: İz harita ekranından tamamen kaldırılmıştır.

test_cases.title: Tanımlı bölgeye giren iz için görsel ve sesli uyarı verilmesi

steps.action: Tanımlı bölgeye giren bir iz sisteme girilir.
steps.expected: Operatör arayüzünde görsel uyarı gösterilir ve sesli uyarı çalınır.

test_cases.title: Tanımlı bölgeye girmeyen iz için uyarı verilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem çalışır durumda, operatör arayüzü açık ve en az bir tanımlı bölge yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tanımlı bölgenin dışındaki bir iz verisi.

steps.action: Tanımlı bölgenin dışındaki bir iz sisteme girilir.
steps.expected: Operatör arayüzünde görsel uyarı gösterilmez ve sesli uyarı çalınmaz.

test_cases.title: Operatörler arası metin mesajının 2 saniye içinde iletilmesi ve durumun gösterilmesi

steps.action: Gönderen operatör, alıcı operatöre bir metin mesajı gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj, gönderimden itibaren en geç 2 saniye içinde alıcı operatörün ekranında görünür.

steps.expected: Mesajın başarıyla iletildiğini gösteren bir durum göstergesi veya mesajı görünür.

test_cases.preconditions: Ağ gecikmesi simüle edilerek mesaj iletim süresinin 2 saniyeden uzun olması sağlanmıştır.

steps.expected: Mesaj, 2 saniye içinde alıcıya ulaşmaz (gecikme simülasyonu nedeniyle 3. saniyede ulaşır).

steps.expected: Mesajın iletildiğini gösteren durum, 2 saniye kuralına uymadığı için hata durumu veya gecikme bildirimi olarak gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Operatör işlemlerinin zaman damgası ve kullanıcı kimliğiyle kaydedilmesi

test_cases.title: Birincil sunucu arızasında yedek sunucunun 10 saniye içinde devralması

test_cases.title: Create a new casualty record with all required fields
test_cases.preconditions: The application is open and the user has permission to create records.

steps.action: Navigate to the 'Create Casualty' screen.

steps.action: Enter 'C-101' in the Identifier field, select 'Immediate' for Triage Category, enter 'Gunshot wound to left arm' in Injury Description, and set Time of Injury to 14:30.
steps.expected: The input fields accept the entered values.

steps.action: Submit the form.
steps.expected: A success message is displayed and the new casualty record appears in the casualty list with the entered details.

test_cases.title: Verify distinct colours for the four triage categories
test_cases.preconditions: The application is open and the triage category selection menu is accessible.

steps.action: Open the triage category selection menu or view a list of casualties containing all four categories.
steps.expected: The categories 'Immediate', 'Delayed', 'Minimal', and 'Expectant' are visible.

steps.action: Observe the colour associated with the 'Immediate' category.
steps.expected: The 'Immediate' category is displayed with a distinct colour (e.g., Red).

steps.action: Observe the colour associated with the 'Delayed' category.
steps.expected: The 'Delayed' category is displayed with a distinct colour different from 'Immediate' (e.g., Yellow).

steps.action: Observe the colour associated with the 'Minimal' category.
steps.expected: The 'Minimal' category is displayed with a distinct colour different from the previous two (e.g., Green).

steps.action: Observe the colour associated with the 'Expectant' category.
steps.expected: The 'Expectant' category is displayed with a distinct colour different from the previous three (e.g., Black).

test_cases.title: Record vital signs with valid values
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record exists and the vital signs input form is accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: Heart Rate: 80 bpm, Respiratory Rate: 16 breaths/min, Blood Pressure: 120/80 mmHg, SpO2: 98%
test_cases.assumptions: The configured plausible ranges include the test values (e.g., HR 30-200, RR 5-60, BP 50-250/30-150, SpO2 50-100).

steps.action: Enter Heart Rate 80, Respiratory Rate 16, Blood Pressure 120/80, and SpO2 98% in the vital signs form.
steps.expected: The values are accepted by the input fields.

steps.action: Submit the vital signs data.
steps.expected: The vital signs are saved with the current timestamp and are displayed in the casualty record.

test_cases.title: Reject vital sign values outside plausible ranges
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record exists and the vital signs input form is accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: Heart Rate: 250 bpm, Respiratory Rate: 16 breaths/min, Blood Pressure: 120/80 mmHg, SpO2: 98%
test_cases.assumptions: The configured maximum plausible range for Heart Rate is 200 bpm.

steps.action: Enter Heart Rate 250, Respiratory Rate 16, Blood Pressure 120/80, and SpO2 98% in the vital signs form.
steps.expected: The application displays an error message indicating that the Heart Rate is outside the plausible range.

steps.action: Attempt to submit the vital signs data.
steps.expected: The submission is rejected and the vital signs are not saved to the casualty record.

test_cases.title: Reject vital sign values at boundary limits (lower bound)
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record exists and the vital signs input form is accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: Heart Rate: 29 bpm, Respiratory Rate: 16 breaths/min, Blood Pressure: 120/80 mmHg, SpO2: 98%
test_cases.assumptions: The configured minimum plausible range for Heart Rate is 30 bpm.

steps.action: Enter Heart Rate 29, Respiratory Rate 16, Blood Pressure 120/80, and SpO2 98% in the vital signs form.
steps.expected: The application displays an error message indicating that the Heart Rate is below the minimum plausible range.

steps.action: Attempt to submit the vital signs data.
steps.expected: The submission is rejected and the vital signs are not saved to the casualty record.

test_cases.title: Offline operation and local storage of 500 records
test_cases.preconditions: The application is installed and the device is connected to the server. The local database is empty.
test_cases.assumptions: The device's network interface can be disabled to simulate loss of connectivity.

steps.action: Disable the device's network connectivity.
steps.expected: The application remains open and responsive without crashing.

steps.action: Create a new casualty record with valid data.
steps.expected: The record is saved successfully and appears in the local list.

steps.action: Create 499 additional casualty records with valid data.
steps.expected: All 499 records are saved successfully and appear in the local list.

steps.action: Verify the total number of locally stored records.
steps.expected: The local storage contains exactly 500 casualty records.

test_cases.title: Offline operation at storage boundary
test_cases.preconditions: The device is offline. The local database already contains 500 casualty records.

steps.action: Attempt to create a 501st casualty record.
steps.expected: The application allows the creation of the record or indicates the limit; if allowed, the record is stored locally.

steps.action: Verify the local storage capacity handling.
steps.expected: The application remains functional and does not corrupt existing data.

test_cases.title: Synchronization after connectivity restoration
test_cases.preconditions: The device was offline and has 10 unsynchronized local records. The server has no conflicting records for these IDs.

steps.action: Re-enable the device's network connectivity.
steps.expected: The application detects the connection and initiates synchronization.

steps.action: Wait for the synchronization process to complete.
steps.expected: The 10 local records are transmitted to the server and marked as synchronized.

steps.action: Verify the server database.
steps.expected: The server contains the 10 records with identical data to the local versions.

test_cases.title: Conflict resolution during synchronization
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record (ID: C-001) exists on both the local device and the server. The local version has been modified while offline. The server version has been modified by another user.
test_cases.test_inputs: Local modification: Age changed to 30. Server modification: Age changed to 35.

steps.action: Re-enable the device's network connectivity to trigger synchronization.
steps.expected: The application detects a conflict for record C-001.

steps.action: Check the application's conflict handling status.
steps.expected: The application does not overwrite either version. Both the local version (Age 30) and the server version (Age 35) are preserved.

steps.action: Verify the record status in the application.
steps.expected: The record is flagged for manual review, displaying both versions for user selection.

test_cases.title: Verify AES-256 encryption of stored casualty data
test_cases.preconditions: The application is installed on the tablet and at least one casualty record has been saved.
test_cases.test_inputs: A known casualty record with unique identifiers.
test_cases.assumptions: The tester has access to the device file system or forensic tools to inspect the raw storage blocks where the application data is persisted.

steps.action: Create a new casualty record with a unique patient ID and vital signs in the application.
steps.expected: The record is successfully saved and visible in the application interface.

steps.action: Inspect the raw storage area on the device where the application data is written (e.g., using a hex editor or forensic tool).
steps.expected: The raw data is not readable as plain text; it appears as encrypted binary data.

steps.action: Verify the encryption algorithm configuration or key management logs (if accessible) or perform a cryptographic analysis of the ciphertext.
steps.expected: The data is confirmed to be encrypted using AES-256.

test_cases.title: Verify battery life under defined usage profile for 8 hours
test_cases.preconditions: The tablet is fully charged (100% battery). The 'defined usage profile' is documented and agreed upon by stakeholders.
test_cases.test_inputs: Defined usage profile script (e.g., continuous data entry, screen on, specific brightness).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'defined usage profile' includes specific parameters for screen brightness, network activity, and data entry rate. If not specified, assume standard field triage usage: screen at 50% brightness, Wi-Fi active, continuous input of casualty data every 30 seconds.

steps.action: Start the tablet with 100% battery and begin the defined usage profile (simulating continuous triage data entry).
steps.expected: The application is running and the battery level is at 100%.

steps.action: Continue the usage profile until 8 hours have elapsed.
steps.expected: The tablet is still operational and the battery level is greater than 0%.

steps.action: Check the battery level indicator.
steps.expected: The battery level is at or above the threshold that indicates the device has not shut down or entered critical low-power mode that prevents operation.

test_cases.test_inputs: A long document with multiple distinct sections containing keywords from different categories.

steps.action: Submit the long multi-section document to the service.
steps.expected: The service returns a response with a status code of 200.

steps.action: Inspect the 'top_passages' or 'explanations' array in the response.
steps.expected: The array contains exactly 3 elements.

steps.action: Verify the content of each element in the array.
steps.expected: Each element is a non-empty string representing a text passage from the original document.

test_cases.title: Error handling for unsupported file format
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A file with an unsupported extension (e.g., .exe or .bin) that is not a valid document format for the service.
test_cases.assumptions: The service supports common document formats like PDF, DOCX, TXT. Executables are not supported.

steps.action: Submit the unsupported .exe file to the classification service API.
steps.expected: The service returns an error status code (e.g., 400 Bad Request or 415 Unsupported Media Type).

steps.action: Inspect the error message in the response body.
steps.expected: The message indicates that the file format is not supported.

test_cases.title: Macro-averaged F1 score verification on held-out set
test_cases.preconditions: The classification model is trained and deployed. The held-out evaluation set is available and labeled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Held-out evaluation dataset with ground truth labels.
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation framework correctly computes the macro-averaged F1 score.

steps.action: Run the classification model inference on the entire held-out evaluation set.
steps.expected: The model produces a predicted class label for every document in the evaluation set.

steps.action: Compute the macro-averaged F1 score comparing predicted labels with ground truth labels.
steps.expected: The calculated macro-averaged F1 score is at least 0.90.

test_cases.title: Recall parity between Turkish and English documents
test_cases.preconditions: The classification model is trained and deployed. The held-out evaluation set contains a sufficient number of documents in both Turkish and English.
test_cases.test_inputs: Held-out evaluation dataset containing labeled documents in Turkish and English.
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation set is stratified or balanced enough to provide a statistically meaningful recall estimate for each language.

steps.action: Run the classification model inference on all documents in the held-out evaluation set.
steps.expected: The model produces a predicted class label for every document.

steps.action: Calculate the recall score for documents written in Turkish.
steps.expected: The recall score for Turkish documents is computed (e.g., 0.92).

steps.action: Calculate the recall score for documents written in English.
steps.expected: The recall score for English documents is computed (e.g., 0.90).

steps.action: Calculate the absolute difference between the Turkish and English recall scores in percentage points.
steps.expected: The difference is less than or equal to 5 percentage points.

test_cases.title: Response time at 95th percentile under 50 rps load
test_cases.preconditions: The service is deployed in a performance testing environment. A load generator capable of sustaining 50 requests per second is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A dataset of 10,000 valid document inputs for classification.
test_cases.assumptions: The network latency between the load generator and the service is negligible and constant.

steps.action: Start the load generator to send 50 requests per second to the service for 10 minutes.
steps.expected: The service accepts all requests without crashing or dropping connections.

steps.action: Stop the load generation and collect the response time metrics for all successful requests.
steps.expected: The log or metrics dashboard displays the response times for the test duration.

steps.action: Calculate the 95th percentile of the response times from the collected metrics.
steps.expected: The calculated 95th percentile response time is less than or equal to 500 ms.

test_cases.title: Verification of request logging fields
test_cases.preconditions: The service is running and the logging destination (database or log file) is accessible for inspection.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single unique document file with known content.

steps.action: Send a classification request with the unique document file to the service.
steps.expected: The service returns a successful classification response.

steps.action: Query the service logs for the record corresponding to the request ID of the sent request.
steps.expected: A log entry is found for the request.

steps.action: Inspect the log entry fields.
steps.expected: The log entry contains the model version identifier, the input hash of the document, and the predicted category.

test_cases.title: Alert generation on PSI deviation
test_cases.preconditions: The service has an established baseline distribution for predicted categories. The alerting mechanism is configured and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A batch of 10,000 documents engineered to produce a category distribution with a Population Stability Index (PSI) > 0.2 compared to the baseline.
test_cases.assumptions: The weekly aggregation window can be simulated or triggered manually for testing purposes.

steps.action: Process the batch of 10,000 documents to generate predictions that deviate from the baseline distribution.
steps.expected: The service processes all documents and records the predicted categories.

steps.action: Trigger or wait for the weekly distribution analysis to complete.
steps.expected: The system calculates the Population Stability Index for the current week against the baseline.

steps.action: Check the alerting system or notification channel.
steps.expected: An alert is raised indicating that the PSI exceeded the threshold of 0.2.

test_cases.title: No alert on stable distribution
test_cases.preconditions: The service has an established baseline distribution. The alerting system is monitored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A batch of documents that produce a category distribution with a PSI < 0.2 compared to the baseline.
test_cases.assumptions: The weekly aggregation window can be simulated or triggered manually.

steps.action: Process the batch of documents with a stable distribution profile.
steps.expected: The service processes the documents successfully.

steps.action: Trigger or wait for the weekly distribution analysis.
steps.expected: The system calculates the PSI.

steps.action: Check the alerting system or notification channel.
steps.expected: No alert is raised regarding distribution deviation.

test_cases.title: Alert generation at PSI threshold boundary
test_cases.preconditions: The service has an established baseline distribution.
test_cases.test_inputs: A batch of documents engineered to produce a PSI exactly equal to 0.2001.
test_cases.assumptions: PSI calculation precision allows for values close to 0.2. The requirement states 'greater than 0.2', so 0.2001 should trigger an alert.

steps.action: Process the batch of documents to achieve a PSI of approximately 0.2001.
steps.expected: The service processes the documents.

steps.action: Trigger the weekly analysis.
steps.expected: The system calculates the PSI.

steps.action: Check the alerting system.
steps.expected: An alert is raised because the PSI (0.2001) is greater than 0.2.

test_cases.title: e-Devlet kimlik doğrulaması ile başarılı oturum açma
test_cases.preconditions: Vatandaşın e-Devlet hesabı aktiftir ve sisteme erişim yetkisi vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli e-Devlet kimlik doğrulama bilgileri (TC Kimlik No ve Parola).

steps.expected: Kullanıcı, e-Devlet Kapısı kimlik doğrulama sayfasına yönlendirilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, e-Devlet Kapısı'nda TC Kimlik Numarası ve parolasını girerek doğrulama işlemini tamamlar.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı, e-Başvuru Portalı'nda oturum açmış olarak karşılama sayfasına yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: e-Devlet kimlik doğrulaması başarısız olduğunda hata mesajı
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı e-Başvuru Portalı giriş sayfasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz veya hatalı e-Devlet kimlik doğrulama bilgileri.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, 'e-Devlet ile Giriş' seçeneğine tıklar.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, e-Devlet Kapısı kimlik doğrulama sayfasına yönlendirilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, hatalı TC Kimlik Numarası veya parolayı girerek doğrulama işlemini tamamlamaya çalışır.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarısız olur, kullanıcı e-Başvuru Portalı'nda oturum açamaz ve e-Devlet Kapısı'ndan gelen hata mesajı görüntülenir veya kullanıcı giriş sayfasına yönlendirilerek oturum açılmadığı anlaşılır.

test_cases.title: 15 dakika işlem yapılmayan oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, sisteme başarılı bir şekilde oturum açmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati manuel olarak ileri alınabilir veya test ortamında zaman bekleme süresi kısaltılabilir.

steps.action: Oturum açıkken 15 dakika boyunca hiçbir işlem yapılmaz (sistem saati 15 dakika ileri alınarak simüle edilir).
steps.expected: Oturum, sistem tarafından otomatik olarak sonlandırılır.

steps.action: 15 dakika dolduktan sonra kullanıcı, sayfa üzerinde bir işlem yapmaya veya sayfa yenilemeye çalışır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, oturum açma sayfasına yönlendirilir ve oturum bilgileri silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: 15 dakikadan kısa süreli inaktivitede oturumun devam etmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, sisteme başarılı bir şekilde oturum açmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati manuel olarak ileri alınabilir.

steps.action: Oturum açıkken 14 dakika boyunca hiçbir işlem yapılmaz (sistem saati 14 dakika ileri alınarak simüle edilir).
steps.expected: Oturum aktif kalır ve sonlandırılmaz.

steps.action: 14 dakika dolunca kullanıcı, sistemde bir işlem yapar (örneğin bir sayfaya tıklar).
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla gerçekleşir ve kullanıcı oturumunu kaybetmeden devam eder.

steps.action: Kurum personeli, aynı bilgilerle 2. kez giriş yapmaya çalışır.
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir, hata mesajı gösterilir, hesap kilitlenmez.

steps.action: Kurum personeli, aynı bilgilerle 3. kez giriş yapmaya çalışır.
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir, hata mesajı gösterilir, hesap kilitlenmez.

steps.action: Kurum personeli, aynı bilgilerle 4. kez giriş yapmaya çalışır.
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir, hata mesajı gösterilir, hesap kilitlenmez.

steps.action: Kurum personeli, aynı bilgilerle 5. kez giriş yapmaya çalışır.
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir, hesabın 30 dakika süreyle kilitlendiği bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Kilitli hesaba doğru parola ile giriş denemesi

test_cases.title: Kilit süresi dolunca hesabın açılması
test_cases.preconditions: Hesap, 5 başarısız deneme sonucu 30 dakika süreyle kilitlenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, doğru parola.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati manuel olarak ileri alınabilir.

steps.action: Sistem saati 30 dakika ileri alınır.
steps.expected: Hesap durumu, sistem tarafından kilitli olmaktan çıkar.

steps.action: Geçerli kullanıcı adı ve doğru parola ile giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: Giriş başarılı olur ve kullanıcı yönetim paneline erişir.

steps.expected: Rapor, WCAG 2.1 AA kriterlerine aykırı ciddi (critical) veya ağır (serious) hata içermemeli.
